text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-senpai, for this summer training 
camp, please let the three of us join you!

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sisters
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes, come along. If I have time, I can 
offer you a bit of brief advice.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Oh, right. Um, so I...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-senpai, I thought of a new vision of 
who you can be!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ho... What kind of idea did you come up 
with?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It might sound a bit cliché, not a ruler, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for victory with the power of our 
friendship! How does that sound?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The power of... friendship, huh? 
...Trainer, a moment."

Only one person was called out. And 
then...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: How could I not be hyped, dammiiit?!
choice_data_list: ...Could it be the power of friendship?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, naturally. What I was aiming for 
was to be a mastermind wrapping every 
Umamusume around my finger. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I wouldn't call it 'the power of 
friendship.' I'd rather not be treated 
like the protagonist of a shonen manga."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What I want to seek out isn't that kind of 
fundamental change, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's an "expansion" of the very concept of 
a ruler.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, not some small fry who caves when 
things get tough like before, but a real 
big shot.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Possessing a profound strategy, never 
getting flustered no matter the time or 
place, and calmly facing down any 
challenge from a rival.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To have that kind of confidence, what kind 
of person do I need to become, and what 
should I aim for?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
How to turn this small palm—into the giant 
hand of God?

Time passed without an answer in sight. 
During our free time, the five of us 
enjoyed playing a board game together.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's play Seven Wonders of the World 
today.

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sister A
text_block_list.text:
“Seven Wonders of the World”... What kind 
of game is that?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, each player takes charge of a city 
with one of the Seven Wonders and leads 
their civilization to victory.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The most prominent feature is that the 
play phase is divided into three distinct 
eras.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The tides change with every era, so we 
must remain vigilant.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Three eras... Oh, there are manga like 
that too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do ghosts show up on your back in the 
third era?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: No... there's no rule like that.

Rulership had been feeling down for a 
while, but through her interactions with 
Kiseki and the others, she was gradually 
regaining her usual rhythm.

"Even if you wouldn't call it 'the power 
of friendship,' this bond is certainly 
having a positive effect on Rulership."

Umamusume and humans alike are fragile 
alone. However, in numbers...

An idea suddenly struck me. One born from 
the mindset of a board gamer.

Or perhaps Rulership's vision of a new 
self to strive for is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What? Form teams, and operate on a 
team-by-team basis, you say?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, gathering the Umamusume who look up 
to her—

Yeah, gathering the Umamusume who admire 
her...

text_block_list.text:
They don't just form up side by side. 
Rather, they gather with Rulership 
strictly at the center.

Rulership leads the group, charging toward 
victory as one. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A commander... A team led by me as the 
commander...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it's an application of 
wargaming, then.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In wargames, 1 unit doesn't always equal 1 
piece of weaponry. Depending on the 
game...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
One unit equals a single platoon. Or 
sometimes, one unit equals an entire 
division.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Not just me alone, but by mobilizing a 
whole group including myself..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Collective optimization. Meaning it will 
lead to even greater achievements, I take 
it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It is a splendid inspiration. However, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What are you aiming for with that group?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If I'm only aiming for my own 
victory, it doesn't really feel like a 
team goal.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the other three haven't made 
their debuts yet. We can't aim for their 
individual victories either.

Come to think of it, that's true. The 
scale has gotten bigger, but there's no 
fitting goal to match it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Just one more step. Just one step left.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Not just me, but what are "we"... aiming 
for?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-senpai! Let's play that game we 
played the other day again!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah, the "Seven Wonders of the World"?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'd love for you to teach me all 
sorts of things, Ruler-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Just like in those generational manga, I 
hope I can inherit Ruler-senpai's moves 
and make a name for myself someday!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Inheriting the techniques... and finding 
success...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: In other words—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Succession... Succession, huh... Three 
eras. To me—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If we consider Air Groove-san's era to be 
the first era...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is the second era. Which means the 
third era is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh, hehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha...! Is this it? Yes, this is it. It 
has to be. The proof being—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The blood boils in my hands. Whispering, 
"You want that throne, seize it."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ruler-senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Kiseki, gather everyone. We need to talk.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I found—a new vision of myself.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, everyone, listen up. From here 
on, we're going to—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We are forming a "division"! The commander 
is none other than myself, Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, you'll officially be acting 
under my guidance and instruction. In 
return, to you all..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I promise you a definitive improvement in 
ability. It's no easy feat, but with me, 
it's guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sister B
text_block_list.text: A guarantee...? Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Many of the Umamusume making their mark 
today fight on sheer willpower. That kind 
of resolve is difficult to trace. However—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I am different. Because I fight with a 
universal 'strategy' that anyone can 
apply."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I will put it into words and teach it to 
you. Yes, behind my strength—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
――There is "reproducibility." That is what 
sets her apart from other Umamusume.

She was certainly right. Rulership's 
strength doesn't rely solely on pure grit, 
making it all the easier to emulate.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And going forward, what I aim for is 
not... merely dominating the Twinkle 
Series.

For the first time, Rulership altered the 
overarching goal that had remained 
unchanged for so long.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Of course, on a personal level, I always 
aim for victory. With all of your support, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there will be races you cannot 
win. You might let victory slip through 
your fingers. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: In return, you'll win in the "future"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The strategies I devised will evolve, and 
be passed down to all of you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The ones who will win in the future 
Twinkle Series are all of you, operating 
under my command."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Meaning what I'm aiming for isn't 
domination over the Twinkle Series, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Total domination of all eras of the 
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What I'm aiming to become—is the 'Ruler of 
History.'

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The ruler... of history... That's... way 
too cool..."

"Individuals turned into divisions, and 
domination gained the vertical axis of 
'time.'"

Rulership finally broke free of her 
wandering and discovered a new vision of 
who she wanted to be.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Our races continue from the past into the 
present. And onwards into the future.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's win against all of them. Kiseki, the 
Raijin sisters.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

A shadow that once was small. Now, bathed 
in the setting sun—

"It became a massive shadow, swallowing 
the sea whole. Large and vast enough to 
swallow even the future."
